description: Start a paid video job with user approval and an exact expectedCredits quote. Required requestId deduplicates identical retries for 24h. Never use a new id to retry an uncertain submission. Returns taskId. For i2v upload the image first; for t2v select a -t2v model.

requestId.description: Unique submission id, e.g. a UUID. Reuse for identical retries within 24 hours; never change after an uncertain outcome.

name: generate_video
